title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 52
description: Ten questions on Psalms 52: the boasting mighty man with a tongue like a razor, and the psalmist like a green olive tree in God's house.

questions.text: According to verse 1, what does the mighty man boast of?
questions.explanation: Psalms 52:1 asks, "Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man?"

questions.text: According to verse 1, what endures continually?
questions.explanation: Psalms 52:1 says, "God's loving kindness endures continually."

questions.text: To what is the mighty man's tongue compared?
questions.explanation: Psalms 52:2 says, "Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully."

questions.text: According to verse 3, what does the mighty man love more than good?
questions.explanation: Psalms 52:3 says, "You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth."

questions.text: What kind of words does the deceitful tongue love?
questions.explanation: Psalms 52:4 says, "You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue."

questions.text: Out of what will God pluck the mighty man, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Psalms 52:5 says God will take him up, "and pluck you out of your tent."

questions.text: Out of which land will God root the mighty man?
questions.explanation: Psalms 52:5 says God will "root you out of the land of the living."

questions.text: What will the righteous do when they see it, besides fear?
questions.explanation: Psalms 52:6 says, "The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him."

questions.text: In the abundance of what did the man trust, instead of making God his strength?
questions.explanation: Psalms 52:7 says he "didn't make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches."

questions.text: What does the psalmist say he is like in God's house?
questions.explanation: Psalms 52:8 says, "But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God's house."
